title: Soul Snack #9: We Are Souls
excerpt: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary dives into the profound connection between your daily choices and the evolution of your soul.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Snack, Gary dives into the profound connection between your daily choices and the evolution of your soul. He explores the concept of the soul as an immortal, energy dynamic guiding our journey through the Earth school. 

This episode offers a fresh perspective on how your intentions – whether rooted in love or fear – shape your experiences and influence the health of your soul.

Gary also discusses the importance of emotional awareness, responsible choice, and aligning your personality with your soul’s wisdom.

By choosing love over fear, you not only nurture your soul but also create a life filled with meaning, connection, and authentic power. He challenges listeners to embrace the transformative power of free will and to view fear not as an obstacle but as an avenue for spiritual growth.

What You’ll Discover in This Episode:

  • (0:46): Why your soul is central to your journey and how it influences your experiences in the Earth school.
  • (8:33): How love and fear shape your words, actions, and karma, and their role in nurturing or hindering your soul’s growth.
  • (10:00): Recognizing physical sensations tied to fear and love to make more conscious choices.
  • (14:40): Aligning your personality with your soul to transcend fear and live a fulfilling, meaningful life.
  • (19:16): Viewing every choice as an opportunity to nurture your soul and embrace your spiritual development.

Soul Step: Reflect on your choices each day. Are they coming from love or fear? Journal about how your actions either nurture or detract from the health of your soul. Let this practice guide you toward creating authentic power and aligning with your soul’s intentions.
